slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots produced per fighter jet allocated to training in each year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked for per-jet training capacity and received 5 pilots per year.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when training starts or how long it lasts; it only asked about allocation independence across years 1 and 2.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in years 1 and 2, starting in year 1 and lasting through the two-year horizon.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training start year or duration, but its formulation uses only x1 and x2 and sums 5x1 + 5x2 as the end-of-year-2 pilot total.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 capacity slot was resolved, but the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 training duration/start slot remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent clearly recovered the P0 per-jet training capacity, but it stopped with the P1 training start/duration fact unresolved and never asked the low-severity pilot-to-combat-jet mapping question.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
